name: HTML5 Platform Submit Queue

queue.accountRequired: CrazyGames developer account with payout profile later, after acceptance and ad eligibility.
queue.rationale: Best current fit for short HTML5 arcade games and later platform-managed ads. Basic Launch can validate review quality before revenue.
queue.adPolicyNote: Standalone builds do not request ads. SDK hooks are present and ad calls remain gated until platform approval.

queue.accountRequired: Yandex Games publisher account and payout setup when eligible.
queue.rationale: Second zero-domain HTML5 platform target. Builds now include Yandex SDK v2 hooks for LoadingAPI.ready, GameplayAPI start/stop, and gated ads.
queue.adPolicyNote: No external links in Yandex context; ads are not called unless platform context is ready and ads=1 is present.

queue.rationale: Fast public mirror and feedback surface. Useful for plays and screenshots, but not the main ad-revenue path.
requiredFields: HTML ZIP with index.html at root
queue.adPolicyNote: Use as a free browser-play page and keep payment disabled during validation.

games.name: Upload Limit Panic
games.summary: A free HTML5 file-sorting game prototype for the zero-domain platform-ad route. Rewarded ad hooks are optional and disabled until platform review allows them.

games.name: Neon Lane Dash
games.summary: A free HTML5 three-lane reflex game for the zero-domain platform-ad route. Rewarded ad hooks are optional and disabled until platform review allows them.
